entries.title: SeoContent — Server-rendered content for crawlers
entries.content: This component renders BEFORE the client-side SPA hydrates. Crawlers see real content with the actual effect library, categories, and platform description. The container is sr-only. Ships zero JS. Adds ~2KB to initial HTML.
